# mime

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: RFC 5322 / 2045 message builder in plain JS, on every host: buildMimeMessage({ from, to, cc, bcc, subject, date, messageId, inReplyTo, references, text, html, attachments }) → the message's bytes — headers folded at 78 columns, non-ASCII words as RFC 2047 encoded-words, addresses with quoted display names, a text/plain (and text/html) body in quoted-printable UTF-8, multipart/alternative and multipart/mixed with base64 attachments (RFC 2231 filenames) — newMessageId(domain), a fresh Message-ID — and its reader: parseMimeMessage(bytes) → the headers (encoded words decoded, address lists parsed, Message-ID / In-Reply-To / References), the first text and HTML bodies decoded from their transfer encoding and charset, and every other leaf part as an attachment (RFC 2231 filenames, Content-ID); decodeEncodedWords / parseAddressList / parseMailbox for headers read elsewhere.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `apps/mail/compose`
    - `apps/mail/providers/gmail`
    - `apps/mail/providers/local`
- Exemptions:
  - Exempts itself from:
    - `endpoints/no-raw-content-disposition` — `core/internal/build.ts` (sanctioned)
    - `endpoints/no-raw-content-disposition` — `core/internal/parse.ts` (sanctioned)
- Core:
  - Exports (types):
    - `MimeAddress`
    - `MimeAttachment`
    - `MimeMessage`
    - `ParsedAddress`
    - `ParsedMimeAttachment`
    - `ParsedMimeBody`
    - `ParsedMimeMessage`
  - Exports (values):
    - `buildMimeMessage`
    - `decodeEncodedWords`
    - `decoderFor`
    - `encodeQuotedPrintable`
    - `encodeWord`
    - `formatAddress`
    - `newMessageId`
    - `parseAddressList`
    - `parseMailbox`
    - `parseMimeMessage`
